Clause 1.6.21 for Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit).

Download **Clause-Setup-x64.exe** and run it. After that Clause keeps itself up to date.
Windows may say it protected your PC (the installer isn't code-signed yet): choose More info → Run anyway.

适用于 Windows 10 / 11（64 位）。下载 Clause-Setup-x64.exe 运行即可，之后 Clause 会自己更新。
Windows 如果提示「已保护你的电脑」（安装包还没有代码签名），点「更多信息」→「仍要运行」。
